action.instructions: Decide what the companion bot does this second. Fight when a hostile mob is within 8 blocks of the bot or near the player and the bot has at least 6 health. Otherwise follow when the player is more than 3 blocks away. Otherwise wait.

criteria.fight: A hostile mob is within 8 blocks (or near the player) and bot_health is 6 or more: attack the mob.
criteria.follow: The player is far away (more than 3 blocks): the bot should walk toward the player and stay close.
criteria.idle: The player is already within 3 blocks: the bot should stand still and wait.

sprint.instructions: The player is more than 8 blocks away and moving, so the bot should sprint to catch up.
